description: Search MakerRadar's directory of launched products by keyword (matches name and tagline), ranked by all-time upvotes. Narrow it by platform, audience, use case or the country it's based in (combined, a product matches them all); an unknown value is an error naming the valid ones. Omit everything to list the most-upvoted products.

audience.description: Only products made for this audience: a slug as on /for (developers, designers, marketers, founders…).

country.description: Only products based in this country: a two-letter code (DE, GB, US) or its slug (germany).

cursor.description: Where the previous page stopped: its `nextCursor`, passed back unchanged with the same filters. Omit for the first page; keep going until `nextCursor` is null to read every match.

platform.description: Only products that run on this platform: a slug as on /platforms (web, ios, android, mac, windows, linux, browser-extension, api, cli).

query.description: Keywords to match in the name or tagline.

useCase.description: Only products for this use case: a slug as on /use-cases.

name: search_products

nextCursor.description: Where this page stopped: pass it back as `cursor` (same filters) for the next page; null on the last page.

makerProvided.description: The listing's own words (name, tagline, description), cleaned of links and other sites' addresses. Unverified: claims, not facts.

websiteUrl.description: Its own site; null while the address is flagged by our safety scan.

title: Search products
